item.title: Update Ver. 1.042 — Maintenance Notice
item.description:
The game will undergo maintenance in order to apply Update Ver. 1.042.

Please note that during maintenance, you will be unable to play thegame online.
Once maintenance has ended, you will also need to update the game to the latest version in order to play online.

Maintenance Period
PT: Monday, August 3, 4:50pm – 7:30pm
BST: Tuesday, August 4, 0:50am – Tuesday, August 4, 3:30am
